sources: Owner-authorised logged-in Threads collection; own profile and search Top results; collected 2026-11-02 America/Los_Angeles
selection: All 48 supplied external paraphrases, no outcome-based exclusion. Own posts: two certainty selections corresponding to supplied images; choose 28 additional posts by deterministic SHA-256(seed + URL) ordering, round-robin across post types, and within each type round-robin tickers. Types assigned from original headline/context before gold: carousel, insider, earnings, opinion, other_news, personal. Record all 107 population hashes and strata without raw text. No replacement after gold or execution.
paraphrase: External input is collector faithful paraphrase as shown (including stated unit errors); do not correct values or add missing years. Own posts manually paraphrased preserving headline/context/quote amounts, qualifications and mixed issuers. Remove promotion/disclaimer boilerplate; do not copy third-party headlines. Model receives paraphrase only, never URL/date/ticker metadata or gold. Whole paraphrase is the direct claim-agent input; actual post CLI separately extracts constituent claims, matching phase 1. Multi-assertion gold records component checks; a verified false component refutes the conjunction; support requires all material financial assertions resolved. Ambiguous year/period/basis goes to review. Price/opinion components are scope expectations, not truth labels.
gold: Same phase 1 independent SEC protocol (L1-L4), standard-library source parser and Decimal arithmetic, without claimcheck verdict code. Search official companyfacts, submissions and issuer-release SEC exhibits for explicit issuer/year/period only. Never repair missing periods from collection/publication dates or matching values. Unsupported domain: scope-policy abstention only. Freeze gold, review list, runtime and source hashes in a local commit before any paid call. Media gold from human visual inspection before OCR; no transcription accuracy claim without reference. Raw images and original media responses stay ignored; public artifacts contain hashes, paraphrases and metadata only.

execution.budget_scope: Phase 2 only: all direct agent, post, image OCR/extraction/verification, retries, failures and retained reservations share one locked append-only ledger. Meta vision charges always debit Meta cap, including Baseten/Fireworks routes. Phase 1 costs remain separate and reported cumulatively.
execution.application_retries: Current production retry policy, each call reserved in the shared ledger.
execution.post_path: One paraphrased story per python -m claimcheck post invocation, same providers and items. Publication metadata is not added as claim context.
execution.order: Run the six image routes first serially (provider order baseten/fireworks/meta, image URL hash order), then three independent serial provider workers, agent pass followed by post pass, same seeded item order. Stop a provider on budget refusal and retain all remaining expected pairs as budget_stopped. No outcome-driven repeat.
execution.retrieval: Fresh SEC snapshots acquired before gold; seeded identically for providers. Other SEC retrieval remains live, hash-stamped and retained. Latency therefore includes warm-source-cache behavior.
execution.cli_transport: Actual claimcheck post and claimcheck ingest CLI. Evaluation-only sitecustomize disables SDK retries, sets timeout 90s, and routes all CLI Ledger constructors to the shared phase-2 ledger with fixed $8 provider caps. No product prompts/tools/checks changed.

metrics: accuracy with Wilson 95% CI on resolved gold; failures count wrong
false-supported among gold contradicted/insufficient with Wilson CI
supported/contradicted/insufficient/skip/failure shares for all sampled items and by type
post extraction and checked-item coverage separately from verdict accuracy
ledger cost per claim attempt and per sampled item, failures included
source-outlet and claim-type breakdowns, small samples labelled
limits: Top search selection, not random population or verified high engagement; engagement counts unknown.
Auto-translated display is the evaluated text, not proof that the author wrote the displayed error. Original-language source not independently recovered.
Repeated issuers/claims and images of two own posts are correlated; Wilson intervals are descriptive item intervals.
Publication date not supplied as model context; undated claims stay undated.
Media uses Meta vision preprocessing for all verifier providers, fresh per route. Retain every paid attempt including errors; no third-party video downloads.

screening.secondary_vocabulary: profit/profits/margin/margins/earnings/growth; EPS/淨損/毛利/年增/年減/獲利/盈餘, digits required

control_rejections.2: investment plan, outside requested non-financial controls
control_rejections.12: ticker overview page without an assertion

screening.note: Human-screened complete numerical assertions in the published title/summary, preserving missing periods. All 60 eligible financial stories retained; no outcome-based replacement. Human screening is not an automated prevalence estimate.

gold_partitions.note: Report primary factual accuracy separately from expected-abstention agreement. Do not claim factual accuracy from scope labels. Review items excluded from accuracy, always included in coverage/cost/failure denominators.

paths.public_news: paraphrase plus outlet/URL/date/ticker and hashes; no original headlines/summaries
paths.primary_sources: sources/*.gz contain SEC primary-source bytes, not feed articles
